card.summary: Free tier: '2 buckets / 5 GB storage / S3-compatible API / Zero egress fees'.

free_tier.stated: Free tier: '2 buckets / 5 GB storage / S3-compatible API / Zero egress fees'.

egress.terms: 'Egress / downloads $0 — Free at every scale.' 'API requests $0 — No per-request charges.'.

record.tooling: Full S3-compatible API 'with presigned URLs, multipart uploads, and access keys included'. Any S3 SDK.
record.chaining: 5 GB x unlimited buckets across accounts; 2 buckets per free account. Zero-egress + zero-request-cost makes it a free CDN origin, not a bulk store.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: not stated on the pricing page. quota-cap: 5 GB total; without a card 'hitting the 5 GB cap blocks writes rather than starting a bill — your existing objects stay readable', which is unusually clean behaviour. retention: none stated.
record.reliability_note: Free tier is explicitly hard-capped and does not start billing, so it degrades to read-only rather than into charges. The opposite of most free tiers.

evidence.proved: 'Free tier: 2 buckets, 5 GB on NVMe, full S3-compatible API', 'Zero egress fees', 'Egress / downloads $0'
